run_GetTestsForAllIterations: run the test program with given env vars and args to collect test lists per iteration
run_GetTestCases: run GetTestCases to extract unique test case names from a list of full test names
run_CalculateTestLists: run CalculateTestLists to populate all test lists including shuffled and filtered variants
test_GTestShuffleUnitTest: test that gtest shuffle preserves test count, changes order, and does not interleave test cases
review_GetTestsForAllIterations: review GetTestsForAllIterations which parses subprocess output lines to extract test names per iteration
